sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (variants: Silver, Gold, Platinum)

room_rent.note: Silver SI up to ₹2L: 1% of SI/day. Silver SI above ₹2L and all Gold & Platinum: Standard Single Private Room. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room chosen.

icu.note: Silver SI up to ₹2L: 2% of SI per day. Silver SI above ₹2L and all Gold & Platinum: no capping on ICU accommodation.

copayment.note: Compulsory 20% co-payment for each insured person aged above 60 years on every claim. Optional voluntary co-pay of 10% or 20% available for insured aged 60 or below in exchange for premium discount.

sub_limits.display: Organ donor: Gold ₹1L, Platinum ₹2L; Ambulance capped; Maternity capped
sub_limits.note: Organ donor: Gold ₹1L, Platinum ₹2L. Ambulance: Silver ₹1,500, Gold ₹3,000, Platinum ₹10,000. Maternity: Gold ₹50,000, Platinum ₹2L. Critical illness add-on: Gold 50% SI, Platinum 100% SI. Main hospitalisation covered up to SI with no disease-wise sub-limits beyond these.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents or if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: Silver and Gold: 36 months. Platinum: 24 months. Best (lowest) achievable is 24 months on Platinum variant.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, ENT surgeries, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for 24 months of continuous coverage. Diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions have a 90-day waiting period if not pre-existing.

maternity.display: Covered (48mo wait) – Gold ₹50K, Platinum ₹2L; Not covered in Silver
maternity.note: Inbuilt in Gold (₹50,000) and Platinum (₹2,00,000) variants. 48 months continuous coverage required. Max 2 deliveries. Not available in Silver variant.

cumulative_bonus.note: Silver: 10% per claim-free year, max 50%. Gold & Platinum: 50% per claim-free year, max 100%. Bonus reduces at same rate on a claim year.

restoration.note: Inbuilt in Gold and Platinum: 100% SI restored once per policy year for unrelated illness/disease only. Not triggered on first claim. Optional add-on available for Silver variant. Gold/Platinum also have optional 'Recharge' cover (Optional Cover 3) which allows restoration even for same illness.

pre_hosp.note: Varies by variant. Best available is 90 days on Platinum.

post_hosp.note: Varies by variant. Best available is 180 days on Platinum.

day_care.note: All treatments meeting the day care definition are covered up to sum insured via cashless or reimbursement.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to sum insured via reimbursement only. Pre and post domiciliary hospitalization expenses also covered.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in AYUSH hospitals or AYUSH day care centres covered up to sum insured.

organ_donor.display: Covered – Gold ₹1L, Platinum ₹2L; Not in Silver
organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered. Gold: up to ₹1,00,000; Platinum: up to ₹2,00,000. Not applicable in Silver variant.

ambulance.note: Per policy year limits. Covers road ambulance to nearest hospital or inter-hospital transfer in emergency.

modern_treatments.note: All modern methods of treatment authorised by Indian Medical Council covered up to sum insured under Benefit 1.

consumables.note: Consumables such as gloves, masks, nebuliser kits, ECG electrodes etc. are listed as excluded items in Appendix List I. IV fluids, injection administration charges and consumables used during surgery/treatment are covered under Benefit 1.

global_cover.note: Policy covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual, half-yearly and quarterly premium payments; 15 days for monthly instalment payments.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: Permanent exclusions: cancer, epilepsy, heart ailments, stroke, CKD, Hepatitis B, Parkinson's, psoriasis, avascular necrosis if pre-existing at proposal. STDs, newborns <91 days, external congenital anomalies, stem cell storage.

optional_riders.display: Critical illness cover (Silver), Restoration (Silver), Recharge/same-illness restoration (Gold/Platinum), Voluntary co-pay 10%/20% discount
